analysis.scope: Descriptive Euclidean class-centroid readout of frozen features; all views of query ancestry excluded. Training images were used to train the network. No independent generalization, causal bottleneck, calibrated confidence or replacement decoder claim. Missing reference classes are ineligible; exact ties abstain. Unknown targets are excluded.
